items.topic: EsmMutations.setAttributes derived-name handling
items.claim: graphql/AGENTS.md row says setAttributes skips derived-name attributes
items.fact: True only for create (name hidden earlier in buildTypeSpecificInput). On update, setAttributes only filters routing fields; a write to a derived-name attribute is rejected by requireWritable with an error and fix line.

items.fact: Module has no JXLS dependency; it uses JasperReports plus XDocReport.

items.topic: Dead config and wrong @Designate in services checks
items.fact: Both are never read; MeasureModel check in ModelsCheck is gated by expressionEnabled. OperationsCheck is annotated @Designate with PlatformComponentsCheck.Config, so its skipMissingSdkOperationsCheck is hard to reach from metatype.

items.topic: ApplicationListener log placeholder and font selection
items.claim: logs model name with '{}' via String.format; picks random font
items.fact: '{}' is not substituted by String.format so model name never appears; random.nextInt(size - 1) never selects last font in the list.

items.fact: Both branches return $1; the IF $1 < $2 branch should return $2.

items.fact: Dictionary with target-name is built but never passed to registerService so has no effect; removeDatasources can NPE on missing registration; liquibaseDatabaseSupplier.target is written but never referenced.

items.topic: DOX rows missing for OSGi service pom.xml files
items.claim: Module-root AGENTS.md is the only one; no per-file rows for pom.xml / TrackerBasedComponentActivator
items.fact: Many pom.xml items (hsqldb-server, jackson-objectmapper, job, karaf-*, datatypemanager, dispatcher) are classified dox but have no row; dox_check value is outside enum ('unverified') so zero-disagreement counts are not meaningful. Existing rows agree but omit public exports/capabilities.

items.topic: Subagent concurrency cap is maxConcurrentSubagents in dashboard config
items.claim: Agent assumed no setting for parallel subagent cap
items.fact: pi-agent-dashboard has maxConcurrentSubagents in ~/.pi/dashboard/config.json (packages/shared/src/config.ts:1113; admission gate packages/extension/src/subagent-fanout-admission.ts). Read once at bridge load (bridge.ts:973) so needs pi reload. Counts in-flight concurrency per session; permit released on tool_execution_end; a saturation sampler narrows cap to one child. Separate modelProxy limits (maxConcurrentStreams 16, perKeyConcurrentStreams 4, perProviderCaps) exist. Cap was 8; raised to 12.

items.topic: Settings should have the subagent cap
items.fact: Operator: 'settinfs shoudl ahve it it is a pi dashbaord subagents feature' — agent should search the pi-dashboard source/config before claiming a feature doesn't exist.

items.topic: New user message aborts running parallel subagents
items.fact: 'Subagent aborted by parent' happens when a new user message interrupts a running round; all in-flight subagents are aborted and must be re-run (reset their queue status from running). Not a concurrency limit.

items.topic: Run 8 then 12 parallel subagents, 12th is the verifier
items.fact: Operator: 'use 8!', 'try 8 again', then 'raise the limit to 12 in config! check the 12th is the opus check'. Round = NREAD=11 readers + 1 Opus check. Estimate for judo-ng read: 112/552 batches done at 12:53; ~7h at 8, ~5-5.5h at 12.

items.topic: Opus check only verifies DOX disagreements
items.fact: Operator: 'quicker check only disagreements!'. validator-prompt.md rewritten; queue.py pick_verify (n_disagree) picks only batches whose reader reported dox_check starting 'disagree'. Each disagreement classed confirmed / omission / reader wrong / correction imprecise and all recorded for review.md. Script checker still runs on all batches. Backlog 32 batches/64 disagreements at the time.

items.topic: Don't start a run after raising the cap; wait for reload
items.claim: Agent had config edited and began launching
items.fact: Operator: 'DON't start after you raised it wait for my reload'. Then 'You did not update it now i did start it! run 12' — agent launched a round while operator had a reload pending, which aborted it; wait for explicit go and re-check cap before launching.

items.topic: judo-ng read pipeline (queue.py)
items.fact: cd target/judo-ng-read; `NREAD=n python3 queue.py next` prints readers+verify; `queue.py record IDs...` checks outputs via check_batch.py and updates queue-state.json; `queue.py status`. Reader subagent_type judo-ng-reader model @explore; validator judo-ng-validator @validate. To retry aborted batches, delete 'running' status in queue-state.json (set verifier to 'accepted'). Reader output out/Cnnn.json; entries kinds dox/src; dox_check must be agrees / 'agrees; omits: ..' / 'disagrees: ..'. Readers get wrong files rejected by checker if outside batch.

items.topic: kb_search only indexes judo-ng worktrees
items.fact: The judo-blueprint kb indexes target/judo-ng-read worktrees; to find pi-dashboard settings search the Pi-Packages/pi-agent-dashboard source with rg. Note rg -E is encoding flag (use -e for patterns, not grep -E). kb guard warns after 3 consecutive non-kb searches.
